title: Jharkhand CM cancels JSSC-CGL exams; protest to continue till CBI probe demand is met, say students
content: “Our demand for a CBI investigation remains unfulfilled. Our hunger strike will not end until the CBI inquiry takes place. It is a matter of great happiness that the JSSC-CGL exam has been cancelled. We will call off the agitation only after the CBI inquiry is conducted, not before,” say students

title: Gangster Shahzad Bhatti picked operatives through social media
content: Bhatti, who operates from UAE, is also a social media influencer; police say he offered money to youth to throw grenades and plant explosives near critical installations and to install cameras near air bases, railway stations and roads; the footage was then allegedly relayed to Pakistan

title: Land acquisition for Tumakuru Node progressing smoothly, says Minister Patil
content: The State government has earmarked 1,736 acres of land in Tumakuru, which has the potential to attract investment of ₹7,000 crore and generate over 88,000 jobs in the State

title: On Nagara Panchami, devotees handle live scorpions in this village
content: Devotees believe that scorpions emerge in large numbers on Nagara Panchami and do not sting because of the ‘divine protection’ of Goddess Kondammai

title: Twisha Sharma case: CBI accuses Giribala, Samarth of abetment of suicide
content: In the chargesheet, the CBI has named Samarth, a lawyer, and Giribala, a former district judge, whom the deceased's family has accused of mental abuse, physical violence.

title: Congress steps up attack on NTA over UGC-NET retest, seeks white paper on cancelled exams
content: Expanding Chhatron Ki Goonj and youth outreach, alleged theft at Raman Mandir in Ayodhya and Assembly polls on CWC agenda

title: Delhi High Court gives Centre two months to act on nursing body’s plea
content: An RTI response from the Centre on July 7, 2026 stated that the NNMC has not been constituted and that no appointment or recruitment had been made

title: Afghanistan Embassy in Delhi celebrates fifth year of Taliban regime
content: The Taliban marked five years in power on Saturday (August 15, 2026), seeking to portray their government as in ‌control even as aid and rights groups warned of escalating crises.

title: BJP MP pillories ‘violent ideology’ of ‘dimagi Naxals’
content: Congress reacts sharply, says the ‘authoritarian BJP regime will try to single out and target intellectuals, academicians, journalists and writers who speak about logic, reasoning, democratic values and just society’

title: Kerala HC directs SIT to conduct foolproof probe into Milma ghee misappropriation case
content: Court notes that certain records were seized from the offices of the Travancore Devaswom Board at Sabarimala, Nilackal, Erumely, Pathanamthitta, Pandalam and Thiruvananthapuram

title: Supreme Court orders restoration of AAP Gujarat's Facebook, Instagram accounts
content: Court allows party’s application subject to removal of objectionable posts, if any, and posts main case for hearing after two weeks

title: CM Revanth opens MCR TIMS Sanathnagar with focus on affordable, quality healthcare
content: The 1,082-bed facility, built at a cost of ₹1,126 crore, is positioned as a corporate-level public hospital with 37 medical departments; CM says specialists serving additional hours in government hospitals would be recognised and incentivised

title: BJP’s Telangana snub shocks leaders, cadres
content: Public disagreements, factional lobbying and social media attacks among State party leaders are said to have particularly annoyed the central leadership

title: Centre says 2026 law does not invalidate identity cards already issued to transgenders
content: Appearing before a three-judge Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, Solicitor General Tushar Mehta said the validity of these cards would not be affected by the new law

title: Food safety crackdown in Bengaluru: Shawarma, kebab, milk samples found unsafe
content: Officials have inspected 629 hostels of Backward Classes Welfare Department, 331 hostels under the Social Welfare Department.

title: I leave it to the MLAs to decide whether they should get up when the Chief Minister arrives, says Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker
content: It is not compulsory to stand up whenever the Chief Minister or the Leader of the Opposition arrives. However, showing respect is part of Tamil culture and tradition. The individual members should decide for themselves whether or not to follow it, says Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar

title: Education Minister Pralhad Joshi tells NTA to audit examination processes, submit corrective action report
content: Pralhad Joshi was informed that “in the wake of recent issues”, the NTA has removed more than 50 staff and advertised for 10 new professional leadership positions

title: Eight killed in hotel fire in West Bengal’s Tarapith
content: The fire erupted around 4.30 a.m. on the ground floor of the four-storey hotel in the temple town of Tarapith, when most of the guests were asleep. Out of the eight deceased, five were from Garo Hills of Meghalaya and three were from Alipurduar district of West Bengal.

title: No State can block traditional routes of elephants: Supreme Court
content: Impeding elephant corridors is not a solution to human-animal conflicts, says SC; it directs Centre to conduct a national survey to remove obstructions from routes and ensure a ban on the use of fireballs and spikes to drive away elephants

title: SHRC directive to address traffic congestion caused by Kochi metro works
content: District Police Chief (Kochi City) told to appoint the Assistant Commissioner of Police (Traffic) to inspect site, probe congestion complaints, and take urgent remedial measures

title: Police record UDF leader’s statement in Kozhikode Corporation anthem row
content: The row erupted after two groups of councillors sang Jana Gana Mana and Vande Mataram simultaneously during the Independence Day ceremony.

title: BJP demands judicial probe, resignation of Forest Minister Ramalinga Reddy over killing of three suspected poachers in Hanur
content: Ramalinga Reddy said the inquiry would establish the facts and that action would be taken against the Forest Department personnel if any wrongdoing was found

title: Groundwater that glows yellow-green in U.P.
content: Decades of industrial waste dumping have contaminated groundwater with chromium (VI) across parts of three Uttar Pradesh districts, exposing villagers to unsafe water and serious health risks. Despite years of complaints and court intervention, the government’s efforts to identify contaminated areas, provide safe drinking water and healthcare, and clean up toxic waste remain slow and inadequate.

title: Police step up surveillance, increase picket points to manage Onam rush in Kochi city
content: Picket points increased to 86 from 42, control room vehicles to 24 from 17; special units, shadow police deployed at crowded commercial hubs and festival venues

title: Some devotees given medical care after rumour causes panic in Madhya Pradesh’s Ujjain; no stampede, say officials
content: At least 10 lakh devotees throng city to visit Nagchandreshwar temple for Nag Panchami festival. Collector says around 10 people given medical care, explaining it as a natural consequence of the large crowd

title: A.P. students bag four gold, 14 silver medals at national quantum computing course
content: At least six medal winners have already secured employment in quantum computing companies, including three students who have obtained jobs with a quantum computing company located at Meda Towers.

title: DRI uncovers illegal use of SAFTA agreement in arecanut imports to India
content: The investigations have revealed the fraudulent import of arecanut, in which the exchequer was duped of customs duty in excess of ₹2,500 crore in recent years

title: I did conduct a ‘limited inquiry’ before accepting resignations of six AIADMK MLAs, Speaker tells HC
content: J.C.D. Prabhakar says he had inquired with the individual MLAs to ascertain whether their resignations were voluntary and genuine

title: Bengaluru: 800 kg gelatin sticks seized from construction site; two booked
content: A rock formation was found at the site during the construction work, following which gelatin explosives were allegedly brought in to blast and break the rock.

title: LDF meeting skips crucial internal issues, decides to focus on local body bypolls
content: Convener T.P. Ramakrishnan says CPI’s demand for the Deputy Leader of the Opposition post was not on the meeting’s agenda. He denied that the CPI’s ire and the feuding within allies such as INL had prompted the CPI(M) to defer the meeting

title: Bengaluru: NLSIU V-C seeks meeting with five-member student delegation amid convocation row
content: Two days ago, the students and alumni of NLSIU extended unconditional support to the students of The National Academy of Legal Studies and Research (NALSAR), Hyderabad.

title: India-Japan defence ties in focus as Rajnath, Koizumi to meet on August 20
content: The Japanese Defence Minister is expected to discuss cooperation on defence equipment, including Japan’s planned export of UNICORN stealth communication system

title: Nitin Nabin announces his team; Smriti Irani, Ram Madhav make a comeback, Amit Malviya out
content: The appointment with the most sharp signalling, however, appears to be in the BJP’s social media team. After a long stint at the helm, Amit Malviya will no longer be in charge. Deepak Mhaskey from Chhattisgarh replaces him.

title: Rajasthan restricts outsiders from govt. schools amid CJP’s campaign
content: The move came shortly after protests were staged in some schools over dilapidated buildings, shortage of teachers and lack of basic facilities; the abrupt decision triggers political row in the State

title: BWF Worlds: Ayush Shetty stuns World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi; India 5-0 on Day 1
content: Ayush Shetty produced the biggest win of his career on Day 1 at the BWF World Championships, stunning top seed and defending champion Shi Yu Qi in a thrilling contest. Led by the young Indian's heroics and PV Sindhu's comfortable win, India made a perfect 5-0 start on the opening day of the tournament in New Delhi.

title: Nitin's 'Nabin' team: BJP hits reset button with eye on UP and 'Mission 2029'
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party has unveiled its dynamic new national team of office-bearers, strategically assembled to tackle both the upcoming assembly elections and the 2029 Lok Sabha contest. This diverse lineup features a mix of seasoned politicians and fresh talent, representing various regions. Some notable figures are making returns, while others have been sidelined, highlighting the party's commitment to revitalizing its organizational framework for future challenges.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes a 'vacation request' to employees for this month
content: Accenture's CEO, Julie Sweet, has requested that employees delay their vacation in August. This temporary policy adjustment is designed to bolster staff presence as the company approaches the end of its financial year. Following disappointing quarterly results and a forecasted drop in revenue, Accenture is permitting employees to carry over unused vacation days into the next fiscal year to help enhance fourth-quarter outputs and revenue generation.

title: 100 days of TVK govt: CM Vijay defines priorities, but his real test begins now
content: Tamil Nadu's new Chief Minister Vijay's government has completed its first hundred days.  The administration has focused heavily on welfare programs and social initiatives.  Significant investment commitments have also been secured for the state's development.  The government has implemented measures to address women's safety and curb drug use. But now delivery of these promises will be closely watched.

title: 'Let me die in peace right now': Chargesheet reveals Twisha's chilling final message
content: The CBI's chargesheet highlights the alleged cruelty faced by Twisha Sharma at the hands of her husband and mother-in-law, who reportedly inflicted mental and psychological torment during their union. Notably, Twisha communicated a final message to her sister-in-law shortly before her passing. The post-mortem revealed that her demise resulted from suicide via ante-mortem hanging, with investigations ongoing as forensic data from devices and CCTV footage is awaited.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40bn in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's philanthropic efforts have made a significant impact by enabling the cancellation of medical debt across the United States. By purchasing and eliminating patient debt at a minimal cost, she has set a precedent that encourages other wealthy individuals to invest in similar initiatives. Despite these immediate acts of generosity, the need for comprehensive policy reforms persists, as true transformation necessitates addressing the fundamental issues leading to medical debt.

title: WC: India coach questions FIH over China’s penalty stroke, later deletes posts
content: Indian women's hockey coach questioned the penalty-stroke rule interpretation after a draw.  He shared footage and sought clarification from the International Hockey Federation.  Former players also expressed their views on the controversial penalty-stroke action.  The coach later removed his social media posts regarding the incident.  FIH had not responded to clarification requests at the time of publication.

title: US researchers release 1,300+ butterflies after just nine were found in 2022
content: Researchers in Michigan have helped bring the Poweshiek skipperling butterfly back from the brink of extinction after its US wild population fell to just nine in 2022. Through captive breeding, habitat restoration and carefully planned releases, more than 1,300 butterflies were released in 2025. The recovery effort has now expanded to other endangered butterflies, while restored prairie habitats are helping support wider ecosystems.

title: 30 lions and tigers leave cramped Argentine zoo cages for sanctuaries
content: Thirty lions and tigers from Argentina’s shuttered Lujan Zoo have begun a major relocation to wildlife sanctuaries in South Africa and the US. Led by Four Paws, the rescue involves moving 30 big cats that spent years in cramped cages and suffered health problems. The animals will now travel to Lionsrock in South Africa and The Wild Animal Sanctuary in Colorado.

title: Nvidia backs OpenAl for its Ohio datacenter to help it get mega compute capacity
content: OpenAI has signed a 20-year lease for 8 gigawatts of AI computing capacity at SB Energy's PORTS-Pike campus in Pike County, Ohio, with Nvidia backing the deal. Nvidia becomes the exclusive compute supplier, invests $1.5 billion in SB Energy, and guarantees the finished data centre's value up to $105 billion. The project promises 35,000 construction jobs and $80 million in community funding.

title: 'It's a lady's sport': The challenge of badminton in Uganda, Canada, Bulgaria
content: The 2026 BWF World Championships highlight badminton’s global reach, with top representation from Asian powerhouses and Denmark. While nations like Bulgaria, Uganda, and South Africa have fewer athletes and limited resources, their stories underscore dedication and growth.

title: House rent in most EU capitals exceed minimum wage
content: In numerous EU capitals, rent prices outstrip the minimum wage, significantly impacting low-income earners. Cities like Prague and Lisbon record the highest rent-to-income ratios, especially for two-bedroom apartments. Other capitals also indicate rental costs above the gross monthly minimum wage. However, Brussels and Berlin provide relatively affordable housing options for those earning minimum wage. The escalating housing expenses continue to be a critical issue for workers across Europe.

title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4: Collaborations, battle pass and everything we know
content: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 Override is set to launch on August 20, 2026, introducing players to a new Battle Pass. The map will experience significant revisions, with several points of interest being replaced by fresh locations. Fans will be thrilled to see the introduction of eight new Sprites, including Sonic and Tails, along with exciting new weaponry such as the 8-Bit Shotgun and Masamune Assault Rifle.

title: From Charles Haley to Von Miller: Jerry Jones’ history of backing controversial stars
content: Jerry Jones champions the idea of second chances in football, seeing promise in players with troubled backgrounds. Charles Haley’s journey with the Dallas Cowboys resulted in three Super Bowl glories, showcasing the impact of rehabilitation. Now, the  signing of Von Miller shines a light on this philosophy, as he too carries a controversial past alongside two Super Bowl triumphs, challenging Jones’ belief in restorative player management.

title: Hockey WC: India’s 32-year England jinx continues as late goals seal 2-4 defeat
content: England secured a 4-2 victory over India in their Hockey World Cup Pool D match. India led 2-1 at halftime after goals from Harmanpreet and Dilpreet Singh. England responded strongly in the second half, scoring three times to seal the win. This defeat means India must draw against Pakistan to advance. The result extends India's winless streak against England in the World Cup.

title: Suthar and Jadeja's first date at Galle: Past continuous, future perfect
content: Ravindra Jadeja's relentless consistency and Suthar's wrist and finger magic combined to give India a glimpse of a potent left-arm spin partnership in Galle. With seven wickets between them, the duo offered India a template that bridges the present and the future.

title: ONGC gets US licence to expand Venezuela operations, boost oil output
content: ONGC has successfully obtained approval from the US Treasury, allowing it to further extend its oil operations in Venezuela. The newly acquired license significantly reduces sanctions-related barriers, paving the way for increased investments and production capabilities. With this development, ONGC can explore new contracts and possibly take over projects from PDVSA.

title: ‘Jana Nayagan’ OTT: When and where to watch Vijay’s final film
content: Jana Nayagan, the much-anticipated final film of Vijay, is set to premiere on Zee5 starting August 21. This political action drama has garnered a varied reception but has enjoyed strong box office success. Despite facing numerous obstacles prior to its release, the film achieved impressive global earnings. Fans can now enjoy Vijay's poignant farewell from the comfort of their homes.

title: Smriti Irani's big comeback: Why BJP has turned to its 'giant killer'
content: Smriti Irani is reappointed as a general secretary for the BJP's national team, a move that highlights the party's strategic push in Uttar Pradesh ahead of upcoming elections. Following setbacks in the recent Lok Sabha elections, her previous success in Amethi positions her as a critical asset. This role will see her coordinating with state units and overseeing candidate selections.

title: Zoya Akhtar confirms 'Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara 2' with Hrithik, Farhan and Abhay
content: Zoya Akhtar confirmed 'Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara 2' is in development with Reema Kagti, though its future remains uncertain until the right story emerges. A 2025 ad reignited fan buzz. Zoya also dismissed criticism about her films focusing on privileged characters, defending her creative freedom to tell varied stories.

title: No new strikes, no peace deal: What Donald Trump’s ‘low-key’ Iran strategy means
content: The United States is employing a low-key strategy against Iran after a deadline expired. Economic pressure and diplomacy are now the primary tools being utilized. The US is maintaining sanctions and a naval blockade to influence Tehran. This approach aims to avoid immediate military escalation while seeking concessions. Backchannel communications continue as both sides assess their leverage.

title: Cong workers sing 2 stanzas of Vande Mataram at Goa rally; Kharge attacks BJP
content: During a recent meeting in Goa, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge passionately led a rendition of Vande Mataram, addressing BJP workers who protested against his convoy, alleging disrespect. In response, Kharge challenged the BJP's claims about patriotism, reminding attendees of the party's historical connections to the British Empire. This demonstration came amidst a new directive from the Union home ministry regarding the proper performance of the national song.

title: DU suspends PhD scholar for slapping professor, bars campus entry; CCTV video emerges
content: Delhi University has taken decisive action by suspending a PhD scholar from its law faculty. Following allegations of an assault on a professor earlier this week, the scholar has also been prohibited from entering university premises effective immediately. The incident, which was captured on CCTV showing the scholar slapping the professor, will now be investigated by an independent committee to ensure accountability and transparency.

title: Kangana Ranaut on 'Bharat Bhagya Vidhaata': 'Patriotism has many forms'
content: Kangana Ranaut discussed 'Bharat Bhagya Vidhaata', saying patriotism extends beyond soldiers to doctors, nurses and ordinary citizens who act with courage. She hopes the film teaches younger generations that heroism exists in everyday choices, not just grand moments. The film, directed by Manoj Tapadia, is now streaming on Zee5.

title: Shabnam Sinha to succeed Sunil Bharti Mittal as Airtel Payments Bank chairperson
content: Shabnam Sinha is set to take over as chairperson of Airtel Payments Bank starting October 1. With Sunil Bharti Mittal concluding his term as non-executive chairman on September 30, 2026, Sinha's appointment is timely. As an independent director with profound leadership credentials, she intends to leverage the bank's substantial growth and enhance digital banking access throughout India, reinforcing its commitment to innovation and expansion.

title: Jadeja scripts history with 350th wicket, joins Kapil, Botham, Vettori in elite club
content: Ravindra Jadeja achieved a significant career milestone in Test cricket. He became the fourth player ever to score 4,000 runs and take 350 wickets. This remarkable feat was accomplished during the first Test against Sri Lanka. Jadeja joins an elite group of all-rounders with this achievement. His efficiency is highlighted by reaching this landmark in under 100 matches.

title: Once plagued by elephant raids, Assam village now grows grass & fruits for wild herds
content: In Hatikhuli-Ronghang village, a remarkable relationship with wild elephant herds has blossomed. By establishing dedicated feeding zones, the community effectively reduces crop damage and tackles food shortages along traditional elephant migration routes. This transformation has allowed farmers to resume paddy cultivation, fostering a newfound harmony between humans and elephants. The Hati Bondhu initiative beautifully illustrates the potential for peaceful coexistence between culture and wildlife.

title: Jayden Daniels’ LSU controversy takes a new turn ahead of the new season
content: Jayden Daniels' LSU controversy has now taken a new turn as ESPN's analyst has reacted to it while the star player gets brutally trolled.

title: “Kelce needs to be respectful”: Travis Kelce faces backlash over anthem behavior
content: Travis Kelce sparked controversy during the Kansas City Chiefs’ 2025 game against Washington after cameras showed him moving energetically during the national anthem. Some viewers called his behavior disrespectful, while others defended him as simply warming up with his hand over his heart. His 2017 decision to kneel during the anthem also resurfaced, adding fuel to the debate. Kelce later delivered a standout performance, helping Kansas City secure a 28-7 victory.

title: Missiles below, mountains ahead: How the IAF had to improvise in the middle of war
content: The Indian Air Force conducted a unique high-altitude air-to-ground campaign during the 1999 Kargil conflict.  Fighter pilots faced unprecedented challenges fighting at altitudes of 14-18,000 feet.  Early losses prompted tactical changes and accelerated the integration of precision-guided munitions.  The conflict highlighted India's need for indigenous navigation technology and satellite systems.  Lessons learned from Kargil continue to shape India's military innovation and preparedness.

title: TVK govt completes 100 days in TN, showcases women safety measures & welfare initiatives
content: Marking its first 100 days in office, the Tamil Nadu government emphasized a strong agenda against corruption, unveiling initiatives such as a dedicated women's safety task force. A landmark conclave secured investment commitments totaling Rs 1.02 lakh crore, alongside the introduction of welfare measures like gold rings for newborns, showcasing a clear focus on accountability and progressive development plans.

title: Amitabh Bachchan leases three floors in Andheri West for Rs 33 lakh monthly: Report
content: Amitabh Bachchan has signed a lease for three commercial floors in Andheri West, Mumbai, with a nutrition brand committing to pay Rs 33 lakh monthly. The five-year lease includes an impressive nine parking slots and a security deposit. This deals underscores Bachchan's significant role in Mumbai's premium real estate scene while he anticipates the release of films like 'Section 84' and 'Brahmāstra Part 2'.

title: Renukaswamy murder case: Court rejects Darshan’s plea for physical presence, allows VC
content: A Bengaluru court has turned down actor Darshan's appeal for in-person court appearances, mandating that he and three others participate in hearings through video conferencing. The Karnataka High Court upheld a prior sessions court ruling that curtailed Darshan's ability to challenge a co-accused's request for a pardon, referencing established legal precedents regarding the rights of co-accused individuals in these situations.

title: 1st Test: Suthar, Jadeja spin India into commanding 178-run lead over Sri Lanka
content: Indian spinners Suthar and Jadeja secured seven wickets on day three of the Galle Test. Sri Lanka were bowled out for 284, trailing India by 178 runs. Sonal Dinusha scored a maiden international hundred while Niroshan Dickwella made 80. Their partnership delayed the Sri Lankan collapse against the Indian attack. India hold a substantial first-innings lead after the rain-affected day.

title: Chemistry Classroom To BJP War Room: Meet Amit Malviya's Successor Deepak Mhaskey
content: According to BJP sources, Deepak Mhaskey belongs to a senior BJP leadership from Chhattisgarh's Raipur.

title: Jharkhand Cancels Key Exams: 5 Big Announcements By Hemant Soren
content: The Jharkhand cabinet has decided to cancel examinations conducted since 2014 by TSR Data Processing Pvt Ltd (TDPL), Chief Minister Soren said.

content: The accused had initially fled to Rishikesh to evade arrest, frequently changing his hideouts there, and later moved to Dehradun in 2001, where he assumed a new identity and began a fresh life.

content: The appointments come as the BJP prepares for a series of elections and seeks to strengthen its organisation across states and social groups.

title: Trump's Appeal In Sexual Assault Case Rejected Again By US Supreme Court
content: The Supreme Court did not give any reason for its decision not to hear the president's challenge. The court in late June also refused to hear Trump's appeal against the original May 2023 verdict.

content: The video quickly became a political flashpoint, with Opposition leaders questioning whether some of the elderly people shown dancing had actually undergone knee replacement surgery

title: South Korea Hopeful Of US-North Korea Talks After Trump Cuts Military Drills
content: US President Donald Trump's order to cut military exercises with South Korea caused concerns it might hurt the allies' readiness against North Korean threats.

title: 'Don't Beg': Pakistan's Strict Warning To Hajj Pilgrims In Saudi Arabia
content: The Pakistani Embassy in Saudi Arabia, in a message aimed at incoming Umrah pilgrims and workers, urged Pakistani nationals to comply fully with Saudi laws and the conditions attached to their visas.

content: Information on Instagram showed the account was opened this month. The log showed the username was changed once.

content: The Vande Mataram recitation by Kharge and other leaders took place before the start of a Goa Congress convention.

title: Himanta Sarma's 'Anarchy' Jibe At Sonia, Rahul Gandhi Over Vande Mataram Row
content: Sarma said the conduct of the Congress leadership during the rendition of the national song raised questions about how the party would govern if it returned to power.

title: Vizag Airport Ends Scheduled Flights As Bhogapuram Airport Takes Over
content: According to the notification, commercial operations at the Civil Enclave at Visakhapatnam Airport, located at INS Dega, will cease once Bhogapuram airport becomes operational.

title: With 8 Leaders, UP Gets The Lion's Share In BJP's Big Revamp Under Nitin Nabin
content: The appointments come months after Nitin Nabin, who is the youngest to helm the party, took over as the BJP chief in December.

content: Ram Madhav has been appointed a national vice president, marking his return to the BJP's core organisation after six years.

content: The Cairo meeting marked Hayya's second with Kushner: in October 2025, he led a Hamas delegation in negotiations with Kushner and US envoy Steve Witkoff.

title: 'No one will be spared': Maha FDA chief warns after notice to SRK, Devgn & Tiger
content: marashtra fda commissioner warns of crackdown on ads of prohibited items . "no one will be spared," a day after issuing notices to ajay devgn and Shah Rukh Khan . a ban on ad advertising could extend beyond celebrity endorsers .

title: Watch: Saudi military ship struck by missile in Red Sea; Houthis claim attack
content: the attack was carried out with several ballistic missiles . escort boats sank and others were set ablaze . the claims come amid an escalation in Houthi attacks on government-held areas of Yemen .

title: 'Ready to show degree but ask pawpaw too': Dipke amid row over Boston education
content: abhijeet Dipke has offered to show his degree from Boston university amid questions over his educational background . he challenged prime minister Narendra Modi to do the same . Dipke said he was willing to provide documents to establish that he had attended the US university .

title: Big win for students: J'khand govt scraps JSSC-CGL exam, all tests via TDPL since 2014
content: JSSC and Jharkhand cancelled 14th and backlog exams . protests entered 24th day with 6 on hunger strike . agitation led by the JPSC-JSSC Reforms Manch demanded a probe into alleged irregularities and cancellation of the exam .

title: Trump's foreign policy: Strongmen on speed dial, allies and partners on notice
content: a new defence pact has been signed between the two countries . the move suggests a foreign policy increasingly organized around personal relationships, transactional demands, and affinity for strongmen rather than the institutional logic of long-standing alliances . "Very happy to see" Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign the mecca joint defence agreement .

title: BJP removes Malviya as IT cell chief after 11 yrs; Mhaske to head revamped team
content: the BJP has appointed Deepak Mhaske as social media convener . the other members of the new social media team include Priti Gandhi, Shivanand Dwivedi, alok Bhatt and Arun Yadav . he said he had worked closely with the new team over the past decade .

title: US destroyer was 'dead in water' for 4 days in South China Sea after power failure
content: a US Navy guided-missile destroyer spent four days without working toilets, galley services . the ship suffered an "engineering casualty involving its generators," a spokesperson says . no injuries were reported aboard the ship in the south china sea .

title: Drones target Kurdish PM after Trump names them as key to US talks with Iran military
content: two drones launched from Iranian territory targeted the office of kurdistan PM Masrour Barzani and the residence of the region's security chief . the strikes came after reports revealed that Nechirvan barzani had been used by the Donald Trump administration as a secret channel to communicate with Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps .

title: 'Trump suffering delusions': Iran military denies direct backchannel talks with US
content: IRGC denies the claim that the united states was engaged in backchannel talks with the force over the war . the reported channel was facilitated in part by the iraqi president . a spokesperson for barzani confirmed to Iran international that he had helped relay messages between Washington and Tehran .
